title: Build an AI Email Assistant Agent – Next.js + Supabase + OpenAI/Claude

feed.title: Build an AI Email Assistant Agent – Next.js + Supabase + OpenAI/Claude
feed.description:
We're looking for an experienced AI/full-stack engineer to help build an AI-powered email assistant using Next.js, Supabase, and modern LLMs such as Claude and OpenAI.

The goal is to create an intelligent email agent that connects to a user's Gmail account, understands incoming emails, drafts context-aware replies, and can optionally send emails automatically.

Core Features

Gmail Integration
Secure OAuth authentication with Gmail
Read and process incoming emails
Monitor new emails in near real time
Maintain conversation/thread context

AI Reply Generation
Generate high-quality email replies using Claude and/or OpenAI
Multiple reply tones, for example:
Professional
Friendly
Concise
Formal
Casual
Allow users to provide additional instructions before generating a reply (e.g. "decline politely", "ask for a meeting next week", etc.)
Support conversation history for more relevant responses
Sending Modes

The agent should support two operating modes:

1. Approval Mode

AI drafts the reply
User reviews and edits if needed
User approves before the email is sent

2. Autonomous Mode

AI automatically generates and sends replies based on configured rules
Users should be able to define when autonomous replies are allowed
Calendar Integration
Connect to Google Calendar
Detect meeting requests, appointments, deadlines, and date/time references from emails
Create calendar events automatically when appropriate
Avoid duplicate events
Request clarification only when the email lacks enough information
User Dashboard
Connect/disconnect Google account
Configure AI preferences
Select default reply tone
Toggle between Approval and Autonomous modes
View email activity and AI-generated replies
Manage AI instructions and automation rules

Tech Stack
Next.js
Supabase (Auth, Database, Edge Functions if appropriate)
OpenAI API
Anthropic Claude API
Gmail API
Google Calendar API

Ideal Experience

We're looking for someone with experience in:

AI agents
LLM integrations
Prompt engineering
Gmail API
Google Calendar API
OAuth authentication
Next.js
Supabase
Background jobs and asynchronous processing
Building production-ready AI applications

Please Include

When applying, please share:

Similar AI agent projects you've built
Experience with Gmail and Google Calendar APIs
Experience with OpenAI and/or Claude
Your proposed architecture for this system
Estimated timeline
Fixed-price or hourly rate
